description: Thirty-two 64 x 64 patches of numerical breast phantoms, eight per breast type A-D, each containing one target lesion (target_mask) among all lesions (circle_mask).
source: 2D Acoustic Numerical Breast Phantoms and USCT Measurement Data, Harvard Dataverse, doi:10.7910/DVN/CUFVKE (CC0 1.0)
conversion: model units = speed of sound in m/s * 8 / 1450
records: records_test.json lists, per patch, the phantom identifier, breast type, speed range and target-lesion size.
